title: ListDirectory
description: List the contents of a directory. Returns entries with type (file/directory/symlink), size, and modification time.

path.description: Path to the directory, relative to the workspace root or absolute.

recursive.description: If true, list recursively. Use with caution on large directories — the result is truncated to the character budget.

include_hidden.description: If true, include hidden files (dotfiles). Default false.
